_provenance: Final configuration (2026-11-05), under the organisers' rules clarification of 2026-11-03: every setting is chosen on external data only (open-data cross-validation), never on the provided match's ground truth or video. Members: tempolens_rnd4_m0..2.pt, trained on the 10 open matches with domain randomisation (python -m tempolens.train --member k --draws 4; CV ensemble 0.7716 vs 0.7636 without). Decoder costs (switch 2, alive>dead 2, dead>alive 2, change bonus 0.5) are the argmax of that CV (experiments --model ensemble --draws 4). Test-time adaptation, EATA and the team-evidence gate are off: in the open-data adaptation study (python -m tempolens.adaptcv; simulated, shifted and 20 real SkillCorner matches) the best adaptation gained +0.0043, under the +0.005 bar fixed before the run.
_tag_prior: 'auto' adds the self-calibrated Smart Tagging prior (tagprior.py), on open-data evidence: with synthetic tags on the cross-validated ensemble and these costs (python -m tempolens.tagstudy --draws 4 --seeds 3) spellF1 0.7716 without the prior, 0.7825 / 0.7767 / 0.7748 / 0.7736 / 0.7715 at 0 / 10 / 20 / 35 / 50% tag team error: it never hurts.
